description: Detach a custom domain from a site. The site itself is unaffected and keeps serving on its platform subdomain (e.g. {name}.vibedeploy.be).

domain.description: The custom domain to remove, e.g. 'shop.example.com'. Provide this or recordId.

recordId.description: The recordId returned by add_custom_domain or list_custom_domains. Provide this or domain.

siteName.description: The site to detach the domain from.

name: remove_custom_domain
title: Detach a custom domain
